upcoming.title: Neighborhood Clean-Up Day
upcoming.body:
Join Us for Neighborhood Clean-Up Day!

Mark your calendars! Our Neighborhood Clean-Up Day is set for Saturday, April 25th from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00a.m. 

We’ll kick things off at 9:00 a.m. at Bryn Mawr Presbyterian Church. Supplies—gloves, pickers, and buckets—will be provided.

From there, we’ll split into teams to walk through our neighborhood picking up trash and clearing storm drains. 

Stay for an hour or for two—every bit of help makes a difference! 

Let us know you're coming by emailing Jillian Lydell, Area 6 and Adopt-A-Drain Rep at jillian.lydell@bmna.org.

Come lend a hand, meet your neighbors, and help keep our community looking its best.
upcoming.excerpt: Join Us for Neighborhood Clean-Up Day!

upcoming.title: Piecycle Pastry Ride
upcoming.body:
April Piecycle Ride  - 4/26 at 2pm @ Bryn Mawr Meadows Park Playground  


Join the Bryn Mawr Active Transportation Committee and Piecycle for our "season opener" bike ride. We'll meet at the playground at Bryn Mawr Meadows Park (on Morgan and Laurel) at 2:00 PM and roll out at 2:15 on Sunday, April 26th.  We plan to ride to Diane’s Place in Northeast - just under 4 miles - via the newly reopened Cedar Lake Trail.  We will enjoy pastries and drinks at the end of the ride.  The ride is family friendly, and riders of all skills and paces are welcome.

upcoming.title: Festival of Garage Sales
upcoming.body:
This event draws people from across the state.  Neighbors open their garages and sell their unwanted treasures. This event draws people from across the state. There will be food trucks plus delicious food from our own La Mesa, Cuppa Java, and Bryn Mawr Pizza and Deli. Neighbors open their garages and sell their unwanted treasures. There will be more than 100 garage sales in Bryn Mawr.

Register your garage sale with the Bryn Mawr Neighborhood Association and your sale will be on our map. The map will be published on our website Friday evening. You will also receive a sign showing you are a registered sale.  The registration fee helps the BMNA cover the costs of printing/promoting the event, traffic control, coordinating food trucks, and portable bathrooms. The Epilepsy Foundation will pick up any unsold items. Register online starting April 1 using this link or complete the form in The Bugle and mail to BMNA, 2915 S Wayzata Blvd, Minneapolis, MN 55405.

Click here for interactive map and list of every garage sale.
upcoming.excerpt: This iconic neighborhood-wide garage sale has a long history. Started in the 1970s, the festival draws people from all over the city and beyond to Bryn Mawr for over 100 garage sales, along with eating and shopping at our local stores.

upcoming.title: Walk to Art Fair at Walker Sculpture Garden
upcoming.body:
Walk to Art Fair - Mother's Day Weekend - Saturday 5/9 at 2:00pm @ Bryn Mawr Meadows Playground

Join the Bryn Mawr Active Transportation Committee for a neighborhood walk to the Sculpture Garden Art Fair on Saturday, May 9 (rain date: Sunday, May 10.). We’ll meet at Bryn Mawr Meadows Park, by the playground, at 2:00 pm and head out at 2:10 pm for a relaxed, family-friendly walk to the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden to enjoy local art, food trucks, and music. 

Our route will be about ~3/4 mile from the Meadows to the Sculpture Garden. Afterwards, you're welcome to join us for happy hour or head back on your own.

Gear up for more Active Transportation events each month and stay tuned by following @activetransit.brynmawr on Instagram or email activetransit@bmna.org to learn more.

past.title: Spring Fest 2026
past.body:
Join us on Thursday, April 9, 2026, from 6–10 PM at La Doña Cervecería for an evening of food, music, and community. With public funding uncertain, community participation and business partnership are more important than ever. Your support helps sustain the programs that keep Bryn Mawr connected and thriving.

Your Ticket Includes:

  • A full buffet with fresh, flavorful dishes for every palate, including dessert

  • One complimentary beer ticket per adult guest

  • Live music and entertainment by Deacon Warner and Big Trees throughout the evening

  • Access to the Silent Auction

  • Adult tickets: $30 in advance, $35 at the door

  • Kids tickets: $15 in advance, $20 at the door (kids under 5 are free)

Tickets & Donations:

  • Purchase your tickets or become a sponsor here

  • Interested in donating an item to the silent auction? Please email Lynda at coordinator@bmna.org

We’re excited for this celebration of community and hope everyone will join us for a night of great food, music, and fun!

Current list of Sponsors, still time to join the list!

Platinum La Doña Cervecería, Eisner Advisory Group LLC, Further Performance, Greg Koch/Graffiti Mill LLC, Dr. Jay Williams, Mill City Dental Gold Bryn Mawr Soap, Alexander Group, spruce, EdgeWork Design Build, Susan Stryker and Annie Child, Coldwell Banker Realty Silver Dr. Talia Jackson, Bryn Mawr Chiropractic, Big Hill Books, Moodyland Outdoor Services, Mary Bolla, Scott Hvidsten and Paul Griffin, Marion Greene, Jay Peterson and Kathy Ripke

Walk to SpringFest! Join the Active Transportation Committee on April 9 at 5:30pm at the Garden of Hope & Healing (420 Cedar Lake Road South) for the walk to La Doña. Meet at 5:30pm and walk over at 5:40pm. Event starts at 6pm.

past.title: Racial Justice Film Series “THIS LAND:  Access and Equity in Minnesota”
past.body:
The Racial Justice Committee of the BMNA is happy to announce the continuation of our film series.  This year the film “THIS LAND:  Access and Equity in Minnesota”, a film by Eva Barr and Michelle de la Vega, has been selected for a screening by the Racial Justice Committee of the BMNA.  The film will be shown on the 25th of February in the SRF auditorium in the old Target headquarters at 3701 Wayzata Blvd at 7:00 p.m.

The film documents and discusses the promise and challenges of emerging farmers of color here in the state of Minnesota.  There will be a panel discussion following the film.  We have invited panel members; Patrice Bailey, assistant director of the MN department of agriculture, David Irwin, Community Education Coordinator at North High School and Marcus Carpenter, Founder of Route 1, an organization dedicated to increasing diversity and equity in our food system.  Mr. Bailey contributed to the film and is engaged in an ongoing effort to support emerging farmers of color in the state of Minnesota.  Mr. Irwin and his wife started a farm in North Minneapolis.  The mission of Route 1, founded by Mr. Carpenter, is “To increase food access in our communities and eradicate, dismantle and disrupt the inequity and lack of representation within the agricultural production, processing, and food delivery system.”

We find the many questions surrounding entry into farming intriguing.  I am sure many of you also have questions concerning how one might go about getting into farming.  So, bring a curious mind and maybe a question or two to the movies.  Popcorn and water will be provided.

past.title: Paint the Pavement + Active Transit Open House
past.body:
At the transportation open house, neighbors will be tabling to engage the community about new art coming to Bryn Mawr streets. The event will be held on Saturday, Feb. 21, from 1:00 to 3:00 PM at the Bryn Mawr Presbyterian Church (420 Cedar Lake Rd S).

Come to learn more about the community-led effort to use pavement art at key intersections, meet the artist Aza Erdrich Abe, signing party for neighbors living on proposed intersections, sign-up for painting this spring, and ask questions.

Information and background on Paint the Pavement initiative can be found in the September Bugle article and the December bugle.

past.title: Rewrite Your Commute Without a Penn
past.body:
The Penn Ave bridge closure is coming this February—but you don’t have to face the detour alone.  Join the Bryn Mawr Active Transportation Committee, alongside MnDOT and MetroTransit, for a transportation open house to find your new favorite way to get around and learn about new art coming to Bryn Mawr streets. The event will be held on Saturday, Feb. 21, between 1:00 to 3:00 PM in the lobby of the Bryn Mawr Presbyterian Church (420 Cedar Lake Rd S).

Come anytime - Light refreshments, raffle with prizes & swag provided!

Can’t make it to the workshop? Fill out the survey here or reach out to activetransit@bmna.org with details about your commute and we will help.


Workshop attendees can access a variety of resources designed for all commuters, including:

  • Transit Training: Practice loading your bike on the bus! A Metro Transit bus will be on-site for hands-on practice using bike racks, and Metro Transit staff will give a presentation to help you learn the ropes of bus commuting.  Community members will also be available to answer questions about paying for bus rides and using the Transit app to make bus commuting smoother. 

  • Commuter Networking: Tools and resources to help neighbors coordinate carpools and shared commutes.

  • Winter Cycling: Demonstrations on gear and techniques for biking safely in and comfortably in cold weather.

  • Pedestrian Routes: Maps and advice for Bryn Mawrtians looking to incorporate more walking into their daily routines.

  • Paint the Pavement Kick-Off: Learn more about the community-led effort to use pavement art at key intersections, meet the artist Aza Erdrich Abe, signing party for neighbors living on proposed intersections, sign-up for painting this spring, and ask questions.

  • Build Community: Mingle, enjoy refreshments, connect with neighbors, and celebrate together.  

Whether you are a seasoned cyclist or a first-time bus rider, this workshop offers practical, neighborhood-specific solutions to stay mobile during the upcoming construction. Even without Penn Ave, you've got options to rewrite your commute.

If you have any questions, check in with us on Instagram (@activetransit.brynmawr), via email (activetransit@bmna.org), or on the BMNA's website: bmna.org/upcoming-events/rewrite-your-commute-without-a-penn

Details on closure: The Penn Ave bridge over I-394 will be closed from February 2026 until November 2026. See full details on MnDOT’s website: Penn Ave / I-394 reconstruction (Stage 2).
past.excerpt: The Penn Avenue bridge over I-394 will be completely closed for a few weeks starting in February. Join your neighbors as we workshop alternative ways to get in and out of Bryn Mawr without the bridge. More details TBA

past.title: Saturnalia
past.body:
Our last Bryn Mawr Neighborhood Association event of 2025.  This event has something for everyone.

3:30-5pm Create snowflakes in the basement of Big Hill Books.  We will decorate the windows of our downtown businesses with snowflakes of all sizes and colors.  This project is for all ages.  Children need an adult with them.    

4:30-6pm Dance to Smiling Drum Corp on stage at Big Hill Books.  Join the fun and bang on a drum.  

4:30-6pm Sip hot cocoa from Cuppa Java at Spruce Salon.  Grab a treat and shop the Bryn Mawr Neighborhood Association merchandise.  

4:30-6pm Visit Santa inside Greenhouse Salon. Greenhouse Salon and Shop will have Aura Photography for a fee, locally sourced gifts & a seasonal cocktail offering.

4:30-6pm Enjoy Rod Gordon on the piano at Cuppa Java playing all your favorite, cheerful tunes.  

7-9pm Unwind with jazz songs of the season by RetroFizz at Cuppa Java.  

The following businesses are offering these specials in honor of Saturnalia….

spruce-artist pop up, 4:30-8:30  with Bill Moran, letter press, Lynn Tanaka, zen rocks, Bryan Ball, pottery, Carter Green, artisan baked goods, Judy O's live music. Cocoa, treats, and BMNA merchandise.

Big Hill Books-Jólabókaflód Sale. All children’s middle grade and young adult books 25% off. Smiling Drum Studio perform. Craft in the basement.

Cuppa Java-happy hour all day. Live music.

La Mesa-$2 off house wine, tap beer and cider with a reservation.  

Sundog Tattoo- selling $50 snowflake tattoo gift cards as well as accepting walk ins on Dec. 13

Greenhouse Salon and Shop-serving a seasonal beverage.

past.title: Open Gym
past.body: The BMNA and the Bryn Mawr School PTA are sponsoring an open gym night. Kids and a chaperone are invited to the Bryn Mawr School gym on Wednesdays, December 3, 10, 17, January 7, 14, 21, 28, February 4, 11, 18, 25 from 6 -7 pm. The BMNA has an equipment cart with some balls and toys, You are also welcome to bring your own to use. We are also looking for volunteers to put away the balls and equipment at the end of the evenings. Sign up to help out here
